leads.name: Pino de Santo Domingo
leads.reason: Zona Recreativa Pino de Santo Domingo, Fuencaliente, free access, signposted road from the village (festivalesdeespana.com). Age about 400 years comes from that events page only (no height or girth anywhere); komoot lists it as natural monument at 28.50344,-17.84777 (about 50 m from the OSM named tree node 837827112), no iNaturalist or open Commons photo, lifecheck NONE. Single weak source for age, pin not corroborated within 15 m, no photo: needs a photo or an official ficha (Cabildo de La Palma) before shipping. Worth a retry: strong candidate (recreation area, annual feast on 21 July).

leads.name: Dragos de Buracas (Las Tricias)
leads.reason: A grove along the GR 130 leg Las Tricias to Buracas, called 'dragos centenarios'. A grove is not one collectible point; no source names a trunk or gives an age. Only the one individual at 28.78789,-17.97299 is delivered as lpa_004. Commons has photos by Gerda Arendt (CC BY-SA 4.0, 2023-01-19) of an old drago in Las Tricias without geotag.

leads.name: Drago of Puntagorda (Mirador de los Dragos)
leads.reason: Commons category 'Dracaena draco at Mirador de los Dragos' (Frank Vincentz, 2008, CC BY-SA 3.0, 19 photos). Not researched: no source on age or which trunk; no coordinates fetched. Retry via Puntagorda council page.
